text:
maya (Product): Quick question — UX for saving route-level analytics views. Do we make saved views strictly per-route, or allow cross-route pinning? Also need model-level filter persistence. TL;DR: we need clear scoping rules + an API shape.

ben (Eng-Platform): Leaning per-route as the default, but allow a 'share across routes' flag. Otherwise you get accidental global queries and permission leaks.

sasha (DevEx): If we add cross-route, telemetry needs context: query name + filter hash -> route ids so permissions + owner show up correctly.

liam (Analytics): Also capture sampling rate and the eval set used. If we don't, rollouts will have noisy baselines and false positives.

maya (Product): Proposal sketch: saved_view model: {scope: 'route'|'org'|'cross', filters: [...], model_selector: {...}, sample_rate: number, pinned: bool, owner_id: string}. API: POST `/console/api/views`.

ben (Eng-Platform): API nit: use `scope` enum and `route_ids` array when scope == 'cross'. Add `derived_from` so we can support quick rollback to previous view.

sasha (DevEx): UX question: where does 'default view' live? Per-route header? I worry about discoverability. Maybe a compact 'View' dropdown with 'Save current' & 'Manage views'.

maya (Product): Yes — dropdown + quickstarters (eg 'Latency by model', 'Cost by token'). Quickstarter templates pre-fill sample_rate, time range and model filters.

liam (Analytics): Telemetry: tag events with `view_id` when users open saved views, include `comparison_basis` so we can auto-detect regressions tied to a view.

ben (Eng-Platform): Implementation: backend should support materialized metrics for heavy views (periodic precompute) to speed loads and avoid hitting query quotas. Also add `preview(limit=500)` endpoint so Console can render a sampled raw view quickly.

sasha (DevEx): Edge-case: model variants change (quantized vs float) and filters become incompatible. Include `model_version_constraints` in the view and show an 'incompatible' badge with suggested fixes.

maya (Product): Rollout UX: allow a saved view to be 'pinned to rollout' which auto-adds that view to the rollout evaluation set. Option to 'auto-enable alerts' on significant regressions.

liam (Analytics): Alerts should tie to baseline windows + significance threshold. We should store baseline metadata (time range, sample_rate, metric_def) with each saved view.

ben (Eng-Platform): Other API detail: return `effective_scope` post-permission-checks and include `usage_quota` info so Console can grey out heavy queries and show cost estimates.

sasha (DevEx): Microsnippet for contract: 

```
POST /console/api/views
{
  "name": "Latency by model (prod)",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "filters": [ {"k":"model","v":"redwood/7b-v2"} ],
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "pinned": false
}
```

maya (Product): Next steps: ben draft API proto, sasha drop dropdown + save modal wireframes, liam define telemetry fields. Can we sync Friday?

ben (Eng-Platform): I'll have a first pass by Thurs EOD.

sasha (DevEx): :thumbsup: I'll drop a Figma link when ready.

liam (Analytics): I'll sketch telemetry schema and add it to the analytics board.

deploy-bot: Reminder: #console deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT — DB migrations for views must be backwards compatible; avoid destructive changes.

maya (Product): Good call. We'll do additive fields + a migration plan.

ben (Eng-Platform): We'll gate expensive precompute behind a feature flag.

sasha (DevEx): Thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and coordinate with PMs.

maya (Product): Cool — capturing notes here so we can link from the spec.
